title: 第9章 送饭不成反成饭第10章 沈青山赠家传功法
slug: 一年抽取一词条模拟的也可以
lines: 席间。
陈奕听见石三身边，那穿着一身道袍的老头，对石三低声说道。
“帮主，明天该给河神送饭了。”
这老头是黑石帮的军师，石三事无大小，都会咨询于他。
石三点点头。
“让王强去办吧。”
“王强已经喂鱼了。”
“哦……喝多了，忘了这茬，哈哈哈！
那就让老四今晚去码头上挑几个苦力吧……对了，我记得有个傻子是不是？吃的还多！
他必须去！”
听到这话，陈奕眉头微蹙。
他假借酒意，试探了一番。
“帮主，那傻子是我同乡，笨手笨脚的，你有什么差事交给我去做，他干不成的！”
石三听到这话，无动于衷。
“这件事，那傻子肯定能办成，你就安心在我这做教官，来，喝！”
显然，石三不准备给陈奕一个面子。
陈奕没有多言。
还是得靠自己变强，才能解决他和大春的问题。
必须尽快开始第二次模拟！
午宴之后。
陈奕故作醉态，摇摇晃晃的回了自己的房间，谢绝了任何人过来伺候。
一进屋子，他便醉态全无，目光清醒。
【指引任务完成！
【奖励已发放！
“当啷！”
一把赤色长剑落在他面前。
还有一次抽取精品词条的机会。
一个熟悉的光团浮现在陈奕面前。
里面的各色光点，正是一个个词条。
白色依然很多，但相比之前，已经少了一些，因为现在白色词条的概率只有89%了。
“来一个好用的词条吧！”
陈奕伸手一探。
没有任何意外。
摸到了白色词条。
“无妨，这些都是精品词条，即便是白色，也是有用的，不像‘姬霓太美’那种……”
content_en:
During the banquet.
Chen Yi heard the old man wearing a Taoist robe beside Shi San whisper to Shi San.
"Gang leader, it's time to deliver food to the River God tomorrow."
This old man is the strategist of the Black Stone Gang, and Shi San will consult him on all matters, big or small.
Shi San nodded.
"Let Wang Qiang do it."
"Wang Qiang has already fed the fish."
"Oh... I drank too much and forgot about this, hahaha!
Then let the fourth child go to the dock to pick some coolies tonight... By the way, I remember there is a fool, right? There’s more to eat!
He must go! "
Hearing this, Chen Yi frowned slightly.
He pretended to be drunk and tried it out.
"Gang leader, that fool is a clumsy fellow from my hometown. If you ask me to do any errands, he can't do it!"
When Shi San heard this, he was indifferent.
"That fool will definitely be able to do this. Just stay with me as an instructor. Come on, drink!"
Obviously, Shi San was not prepared to give Chen Yi face.
Chen Yi didn't say much.
He still had to rely on himself to become stronger in order to solve the problem between him and Dachun.
The second simulation must start as soon as possible!
After lunch.
Chen Yi pretended to be drunk and staggered back to his room, refusing anyone to come to serve him.
As soon as he entered the house, he lost all his drunkenness and his eyes were clear.
[Guidance mission completed!
[Rewards have been distributed!
"Clang!"
A long red sword fell in front of him.
There is also a chance to draw premium entries.
A familiar light group appeared in front of Chen Yi.
The various colored light spots inside are exactly entries.
There is still a lot of white, but it is less than before, because now the probability of white entries is only 89%.
"Come on a useful term!"
Chen Yi stretched out his hand to explore.
No surprises.
Touched the white entry.
"It doesn't matter, these are high-quality entries. Even if they are white, they are still useful. They are not like 'Ji Ni is too beautiful'..."
